name: aws-lan-mesh-c7g
setup: AWS us-west-2a, one subnet (a datacenter LAN, not a wired office LAN): coordinator c7g.large (cua daemon + SDK) -> pool host c7g.metal (Linux VM Space, QEMU/KVM, 2 vCPU, 2 GiB, created with --on host:<machine>) over the mesh's direct path; self-hosted relay (account mode, mesh on) in the same AZ. The guest ran this branch's cua-spacesd (overlaid). Measured 2026-10-20 with this branch.
